title: share-account list row for account id 3: stored status 300, approved 100, pending 0 (no purchase group)
_note: share-account seam, LIST-ROW IDENTITY. request.account_status_id 300 and expect.account_status_stored 300 are shares-accounts-list-raw.json pageItems[0].status.id (shareAccountStatusType.active) for account id 3. request.total_approved_shares 100 and expect.total_approved_shares 100 are summary.totalApprovedShares; request.total_pending_shares 0 and expect.total_pending_shares 0 are summary.totalPendingForApprovalShares. A share-account LIST row serialises NO purchasedShares group (the list omits it), so this vector carries no purchase fields on either side: a port that fills the purchase group from a list row has nothing to read and must leave it silent. The stored status integer 300 is what a status-iota-ordinal defect would re-encode as 3, so this vector is red for it. The pending fold is 0 against the approved fold 100, so the summary-transpose defect shares-wrong-summary-approved-as-pending encodes (filling totalPendingForApprovalShares from totalApprovedShares, writing 100 into the 0 cell) also goes red here.

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/shares-accounts-list-raw.json (account id 3, pageItems[0]): status.id 300, summary.totalApprovedShares 100, summary.totalPendingForApprovalShares 0; the list row carries no purchasedShares group.
